method: Product identity and exact image URLs were observed in successful HTTP 200 responses from public Amazon Brazil product pages. Manufacturer specifications were verified on Logitech G Brazil product pages, including their public structured data. Downloaded photographs were inspected visually and pixel dimensions read from the files.
offerPolicy: No current price, discount, stock, rating or review-count claims were collected or approved. Product-page identity verification does not imply current offer availability.
